Ensembles stores all sync data as
binary files attached to CloudKit records — not as structured record fields. The contents are opaque serialized event logs that are not human-readable, even without encryption.
CloudKit encrypts all data at rest on Apple’s servers. With
data is end-to-end encrypted — Apple cannot read it. Without ADP, Apple manages the encryption keys and could theoretically access the data.
For apps that need end-to-end encryption regardless of the user’s ADP setting, wrap the CloudKit backend with
This encrypts data with AES-256-GCM before it ever reaches CloudKit, so security does not depend on Apple’s infrastructure.
